turns.replyText:
2:02 PM. You said:

How do I use it properly the very first time?

02:02 PM

I understand wanting to get the first use right. For the C500 Pro, follow these steps while it is still open:

Choose a memorable 5 to 6 digit code. Do not use an obvious sequence or personal date, and use each number only once. There is no reset or override code, so record it securely.
Pull open the weather cover, press CLEAR, then turn the OPEN handle clockwise 180° to open the lid.
Slide out the plastic instruction card near the hinge. On the back of the lid, use the supplied code-change tool to set your chosen buttons to ON, with the arrows pointing towards the hinge. Leave the other buttons OFF.
Turn the OPEN handle counter-clockwise 180° to the locked position before changing the code. Do not use a screwdriver.
Test the code with the lid open: press CLEAR, press only your chosen buttons until they click, then turn OPEN clockwise 180°. If you press the wrong button, press CLEAR and start again.
To use it normally, press CLEAR, enter the code in any order, and turn OPEN clockwise 180°. To lock it, close the lid and turn OPEN counter-clockwise 180°.

For the complete illustrated instructions, see the C500 Pro User Guide or watch the C500 Pro code-setting video.
